name: What if the other driver has insufficient insurance for my property damage?

mainEntity.name: What if the other driver has insufficient insurance for my property damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If their liability coverage doesn’t fully cover your damages, you may claim under your collision coverage or pursue the driver personally for the remaining amount.missionlegalcenter​
